channel.desc: Bienvenue to a very special episode of the show from Amiens in northern France! Twice a year, a huge fair bursting with antiquit?s takes over the city's streets, drawing 80,000 bargain hunters from across Europe. Among them are a red and a blue team of bargain hunters - one French and one British - ready for an international battle, the likes of which have not been seen since the Battle of Hastings!
